a.lede: Cisco released security updates to patch a denial-of-service zero-day in Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Threat Defense (FTD) software that attackers are exploiting to remotely crash vulnerable firewall devices. [...]
a.title: New Cisco firewall zero-day exploited to crash SSL VPN devices

b.lede: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned federal agencies to patch a high-severity Linux kernel privilege escalation bug that attackers are chaining with the PHP2Shell flaws in the wild. [...]
b.title: CISA warns of Fragnesia Linux flaw chained in PHP2Shell attacks
